title: Key transit routes
steps: Izumo Airport (IZO) → Matsue — airport limousine bus, departs ≈10 min after each arriving flight's baggage claim opens; confirm you're on the Matsue-route bus, not the Izumo-route one. Buy your ticket at the counter or on board.

Getting around Matsue — the Matsue Lake Line loop bus runs ≈every 30 min (full loop ≈50 min), {{fact:matsue-lake-line-ride-250-yen}} per ride or {{fact:matsue-lake-line-day-pass-700-yen}} for an all-day pass, and covers the station, the castle, the Horikawa boat dock, Shiomi Nawate, and Matsue Shinjiko Onsen — avoids stringing long walks between stops for the 2 low-mobility travelers.

Matsue → Izumo Taisha — Ichibata Electric Railway, Matsue Shinjiko Onsen Station to Izumo Taisha-mae, with a same-platform transfer at Kawato Station. ≈{{fact:ichibata-matsue-izumo-900-yen}} one way; IC cards (ICOCA/Suica) accepted.

Matsue → Odashi (the base transfer, with luggage) — JR San-in Main Line, ≈45–90 min depending on train (limited express vs. local), {{fact:jr-sanin-matsue-odashi-fare}}. IC cards stop working at Izumo-shi Station — the JR West ICOCA area ends there, so buy a paper ticket (or top up with cash at the gate) before boarding past Izumo-shi.

Odashi Station → Iwami Ginzan / Omori — Iwami Kotsu community bus toward the World Heritage Center, ≈30 min, {{fact:odashi-omori-bus-760-yen}} one way, roughly hourly (with a documented gap around the 10 o'clock hour — don't assume a bus is always 30 minutes away). IC cards accepted on this bus.

Omori townscape → Ryugenji Mabu mine entrance — the Ginzan Cart (Green Slow Mobility), a 6-seat electric cart, {{fact:ginzan-cart-500-yen}} one way, no reservations, first-come first-served, roughly every 30–40 min, 8:00–18:00. Closed Wednesdays and can suspend on short notice in bad weather. If it's full or not running, the walk is ≈2.3 km / 45 min one way on an unpaved forest trail — plan real time for this, not a placeholder, if traveling with the two low-mobility members of the group. A rental e-bike from Daikansho Plaza ({{fact:iwami-ginzan-ebike-700-yen}} for 2hr) is a confirmed third option.

Last practical return, Odashi → Matsue — the last convenient upbound JR service leaves Odashi ≈19:24 (Super Oki service toward Yonago, calling at Matsue). Missing it means either a very late connection or an unplanned night away from your booked base — build the Iwami Ginzan day around this deadline, not around the cart's own 18:00 close.
Omori/Odashi → Izumo Airport (departure day) — reverse the JR leg to Izumo-shi, then the airport limousine bus or a taxi for the final stretch; there's no direct rail into the airport itself.
